craft_notes: Sthāyin: chasm-rite — hurled yet gentle. Rows: hurl then hold. Rejected: hell-reading — killed: adjudicated chasm. Read aloud: leap, then calm.

lines: In a far-off chasm hurl your frame in a flash — dwell gently, no force —
gather both hands, gaze outward: serve this sky-faring seal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svadehaṃ saṃpātayan vāsam asāhasena ākuñcya hastadvitayaṃ prapaśyan mudrām imāṃ vyomacarīṃ bhajeta
